declaration.question: Does a mild, censored short-spell loss weight, a fixed transition surrogate, or their combination improve full-provider-holdout possession scores over the adopted slot-dropout joint GRU?
declaration.hypothesis: The short-spell weight should improve missed brief H/A spells; transition supervision should improve H/A turnover timing and state boundaries. Their combined arm tests additive value.

training_control.reused_training_record_recipe: Recreated under the separately frozen objective-alignment preparation declaration.

matched_scoring_reference.role: Exact archived score parity check for the six slot-dropout controls on clean and feed_like cells.

calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

declaration.training_recipe: Adopted factorized player-only joint GRU. Reuse exact clean/legacy plus 25% whole-window ball-gap and player-slot-dropout records, equal provider/match mass, train-only normalization, 5 Hz, 10 s core plus 5 s context on both sides, hidden size 24, 8 epochs, AdamW .001/.0001, batch 64, gradient clip 1, direct and H/A-swapped records. Loss objective is the only change.
declaration.short_spell_weight: At native frame resolution, weight only complete H/A runs. A run touching a match/time-block edge or adjacent X/unknown label is censored and stays neutral. D and unknown targets stay neutral. Per-spell factor is clip(sqrt(5 seconds / duration), 0.5, 2.0); normalize factors to mean 1 over eligible complete-spell sampled H/A rows within each record. Apply the factor only to conditional H/A classification loss; preserve the marginal D/live gate loss and each record/source training mass. H/A swap augmentation shares the same duration factors.
declaration.transition_auxiliary: No added head. On adjacent sampled known targets in one model period, require every native target between their source indices to be known and in one uninterrupted full-resolution period. Use a marginal P(D) change surrogate whose P(D) comes from the player-only dead path, plus a conditional H/A switch surrogate on adjacent live targets. Each component is cost-sensitive: one half of the stable-group mean plus one half of the changed-group mean; absent groups contribute zero. The D/live component and conditional H/A component each receive a fixed half of the auxiliary loss; absent components contribute zero. Per-source/match weights preserve the existing record mass. Fixed auxiliary coefficient lambda=.1. This balanced marginal surrogate is cost-sensitive and is not a calibrated/native transition likelihood. Combined adds this term to the H/A-weighted NLL.
declaration.training_labels: Use existing external training labels only. Full-resolution labels are mapped to H/A/D ids and X/unknown=-1; spell runs break at model-period and timestamp discontinuities. No evaluation labels enter either objective.
declaration.primary: Equal-provider official mean possession-spell F1, with exact ties broken by macro F1; report every IoU .3-.7. Also report fixed auxiliary .70 spell + .30 macro, not used for ranking.
declaration.guardrails: Per seed: feed_like stress spell F1 at least matched control -0.01; each provider clean D-F1 and macro-F1 at least matched control -0.02. A clean spell gain of +0.01 is the predeclared positive screen.
declaration.budget: 18 new fits (3 objectives x 3 full-provider folds x 2 seeds); reuse six sealed adopted slot-dropout controls (zero new control fits). Score all four arms on five development matches: one clean view and two fixed feed_like stress replicates. Seal every model before any scoring.
limitations: All five development matches were previously exposed; full provider holdout does not create independent confirmation.
Synthetic feed_like corruption is a sensitivity probe, not evidence of real broadcast transfer.
No public organizer labels or scores are used for training, selection, or tuning.
